tm.title: Time Machine
tm.intro: Pick how much you put away each month and for how long. The band shows a range: no one knows the future.
tm.put_in: You put in {{amount}}. The rest is growth.
tm.assumption: These are assumed numbers, not promises. Real growth can be lower, higher or even negative.
tm.what: What this means: money left to grow earns a little on top, and that extra earns too. Time helps most.
tm.assets: Practice names only: Steady Deposit, Mixed Basket and Rocket Co are made up for this game.
tm.q.title: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
tm.q.ask: Which plan ends with more money?
tm.q.ranges: Plan A: {{aLow}} to {{aHigh}}. Plan B: {{bLow}} to {{bHigh}}.
tm.q.why.time_beats_amount: Half as much each month, but four times as long, ends with more. Time does the heavy lifting.
tm.q.why.start_early: Starting early with a smaller amount beats saving double for a few years.
tm.q.why.more_each_month: For the same time, a bigger monthly amount grows to more.
tm.done.title: Time Machine done!
tm.done.lesson: Starting early and staying with it helps most. Always look at the whole range.

bank.jars.hint: Split a payday into four jars and check the plan.
